field_principles.arc_registry_precheck: All target games are checked and no duplicate solve or level claim is made.
field_principles.arc_scope_and_non_claims: The artifact explicitly forbids game solve, level solve, leaderboard, outer-loop RE, and per-game adapter credit.
field_principles.archive_and_split_receipts: Immutable live transition sources and game-disjoint calibration and held membership bind by hash.
field_principles.attack_rows: Off-path, default, identity, leakage, source, ground-truth, timing, control, drop, tamper, and mutation attacks fail closed.
field_principles.field_provenance: Every field names archive rows, code hashes, split receipts, arm reducers, and exact observations.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Any block names the missing transition, split, path, import, registry, hash, control, or resource and observed value.
field_principles.held_arm_summary: No projection, selected invariant, and random control effects recompute from held rows.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The verdict is limited to held world-model prediction correction and makes no solve claim.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The task declares live E3 world-model archive replay through the scored import closure with no new LLM.
field_principles.invariant_selection_rows: Selection uses calibration games only and cannot see held identities or outcomes.
field_principles.live_import_reachability_receipts: make_carnot_agent and E3AgentPolicy reach the default-off projector through the scored import closure.
field_principles.live_projection_contract_ready_score: This exact binary field gates Exp6613 and Exp6614 when the live-reachable comparison is row-complete.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Every game, transition, seed, and arm retains prediction, observation, projection, exact error, validity, cost, and failure evidence.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Prior artifact, registry, entrypoints, archives, rows, splits, resources, and protected files are explicit.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Both protected orchestration files retain original hashes.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A final hash protects the live-path result.
field_principles.runtime_validity_and_cost_summary: Invalid predictions, exceptions, iterations, and charged wall time remain explicit.
field_principles.status: The task ends with live-reachable archive evidence or a named insufficiency block.
field_principles.tests_run: Named live, projector, lint, registry, artifact, adversarial, and E2E commands include exits and durations.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use the closed enum; an exact-next-frame-defined improvement is circular_positive.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Exact observed next frames define prediction error but are unavailable until after each prediction.
field_principles.world_model_and_projector_hashes: World-model code, invariant basis, thresholds, and projector implementation are frozen before held replay.
